items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I made with Mr. Bill Russell. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's the first one I made.

ctx.x: No. Well, progressive, I don't like progressive. And they rock and roll. You best, I tell it, I tell you, one music I like the best, it's western, you know, like that, I prefer that kind of music. But they have nice, you know, they have nice numbers, you know. Because I feel, I feel, I used to feel a lot of western songs, when I was playing for dancers, you know. So, boy, they, you know, they came in. I don't like that, I don't understand it, that's why.
Well, tell me about your first recording session that you ever made. Well, I made with Mr. Bill Russell.
Yeah, that's the first one I made. That's the deal.
